title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Article 30 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, in light of situations encountered in judicial practice, has discussed the meaning of Article 30 of the Criminal Law and the issue of how to apply the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law where a company, enterprise, institution, organ, or organization commits an act endangering society as stipulated in the Criminal Law, but the law does not provide for investigating the criminal liability of the unit. The interpretation is as follows:
Where a company, enterprise, institution, organ, organization, or other unit commits an act endangering society as stipulated in the Criminal Law, and neither the Specific Provisions of the Criminal Law nor other laws provide for investigating the criminal liability of the unit, the persons who organize, plan, or carry out such act endangering society shall be investigated for criminal liability according to law.
This is hereby announced.
